records.text: On May 7, 2023, Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group where transgender stories inspired her; Caroline felt happy and thankful for the support.
Caroline shared a photo showing a dog walking past a wall painted with an image of a woman.
Caroline said the LGBTQ support group made her feel accepted and gave her courage to embrace herself.
Caroline plans to continue her education and explore career options.
Caroline is interested in counseling or working in mental health, and would like to support people with issues similar to her own.
Melanie said she is swamped with caring for her children and with work.
Melanie shared a photo of a painting depicting a sunset over a lake.
Melanie encouraged Caroline by saying Caroline has courage, empathy, and understanding and would make a great counselor.

Caroline and Melanie are friends/acquaintances who greeted each other on May 8, 2023. Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group on May 7, 2023, found transgender stories inspiring, and said the group helped her feel accepted and embrace herself. Caroline plans to continue her education and explore counseling or mental-health work. Caroline shared a photo of a dog passing a mural of a woman. Melanie is busy with her children and work and shared a photo of her own? painting of a sunset over a lake; Caroline asked whether Melanie painted it.
Melanie painted a lake sunrise in 2022, and the painting is special to her.
Melanie enjoys painting because it helps her express her feelings, be creative, and relax after a long day.
Caroline thinks Melanie's lake sunrise painting has colors that blend nicely and views painting as a good outlet for self-expression.
Caroline and Melanie agree that relaxing, expressing themselves, and taking care of themselves are important.
Caroline planned to do some research after speaking with Melanie.
Melanie planned to go swimming with the kids after speaking with Caroline.

Melanie ran in a charity race for mental health on Saturday, May 20, 2023. She found the event rewarding and thought-provoking, and it made her reflect on caring for her mind and raising mental-health awareness.
Caroline believes participating in a charity race to make a difference and raise awareness for mental health is rewarding, and Caroline is proud of Melanie for taking part.
Melanie is realizing that self-care is important. Melanie says caring for herself helps her care better for her family, although self-care remains a work in progress.
Caroline agrees that taking care of oneself is important, even when it is difficult, and Caroline encourages Melanie for prioritizing self-care.
Melanie plans to carve out personal time every day by running, reading, or playing her violin. These activities refresh Melanie and help her stay present for her family.
Melanie's children are excited about summer break.
Melanie and her children are considering going camping in June 2023 during the summer break.

Caroline and Melanie are the speakers. Melanie ran a mental-health charity race on 2023-05-20 and is prioritizing daily self-care through running, reading, and playing violin; she says this helps her care for her family. Melanie's children are excited for summer break, and Melanie is considering camping with them in June 2023. Caroline supports Melanie's self-care and is proud of her charity-race participation. Caroline's summer plans are not yet stated.
Caroline is researching adoption agencies because she has dreamed of having a family and giving a loving home to children in need.
Melanie thinks Caroline is kind for wanting to take in children in need and believes Caroline's future family will be lucky to have her.
Caroline's goal is to give children a loving home, and she feels grateful for the support she has received from friends and mentors.
Caroline says the hard work of turning her dream of adoption and building a family into reality begins now.
Caroline is looking into at least one adoption agency and shared a photo showing a sign for a new arrival near an information and domestic building.
Caroline finds the adoption-agency information overwhelming but feels hopeful and optimistic about the process.
On May 25, 2023, Caroline selected an adoption agency because it supports LGBTQ+ people with adoption; the agency’s inclusivity and support strongly appealed to Caroline.
On May 25, 2023, Melanie praised Caroline’s choice of an adoption agency that supports LGBTQ+ people and expressed appreciation for the agency’s inclusivity and support.

Caroline is researching adoption agencies on May 25, 2023, hoping to build a family and provide children in need with a loving home. Caroline chose an agency that supports LGBTQ+ people because its inclusivity and support resonated with her. Melanie supports Caroline’s adoption goal and praises the agency’s inclusivity. Caroline feels hopeful but overwhelmed as the hard work begins and appreciates support from friends and mentors. Melanie painted a special lake sunrise painting in 2022 for emotional expression, creativity, and relaxation; Caroline complimented it and values relaxation and self-care. Melanie planned to swim with the kids on May 8, 2023.
Caroline is thrilled to build a family for children who need one through adoption. She intends to pursue this as a single parent and feels ready to take on the challenge.
Melanie believes Caroline is doing something amazing by creating a family for children in need and says Caroline will be an awesome mother.
Caroline wants to provide the children she adopts with a safe and loving home and says she will do her best to do so.
Melanie believes Caroline has a caring heart and that the children will receive the love and stability they need from her. Melanie is excited about Caroline's new chapter.
Melanie offers Caroline enthusiastic emotional support and encouragement regarding Caroline's goal of becoming a single adoptive parent.

On 2023-06-02, Caroline spoke at a school event about her transgender journey, encouraged students to participate in the LGBTQ community, and observed that the audience related to her experiences and became motivated to be better allies.
Caroline began transitioning around 2020, approximately three years before 2023-06-09, and has reflected on her growth since coming out.

Caroline shared that conversations about gender identity and inclusion are necessary and that she wants to use her voice to represent the trans community, promote understanding and acceptance, and help build a supportive community of hope.
Caroline felt powerful while giving her talk and grateful, hopeful, and motivated to inspire others and lift them up through sharing her story.

Melanie praised Caroline's courage, strength, and impact in speaking about her transition and advocating for inclusivity, acceptance, and the trans community; Melanie said she was proud to support Caroline's journey.
Caroline said that friends, family, and mentors are her rocks: they motivate her and give her strength to keep going.
Melanie said that her family motivates her, gives her love, and inspires her to be courageous.
Caroline and Melanie encourage one another and want to keep motivating and helping each other through life's challenges while spreading love, understanding, acceptance, and hope.
On 2023-06-09, Caroline shared a photo from a meetup the previous week; the photo showed a family posing for a picture in a yard. The identities of the people in the photo were not specified.
Caroline has known her supportive friends for 4 years as of June 9, 2023, since Caroline moved from her home country.
Caroline's friends have supported Caroline through everything, including a difficult breakup, and Caroline is deeply thankful for their love and help.
Melanie said that Melanie's husband and children support and motivate Melanie.
Melanie shared a photo showing a man and a little girl standing in front of a waterfall.
Melanie has been married for 5 years as of June 9, 2023, meaning Melanie and Melanie's husband married around 2018.
Melanie shared a photo of a bride in a wedding dress holding a bouquet; Melanie identified the bride as herself and recalled wearing the dress on her wedding day.
Melanie shared a photo of a man and woman sitting on a blanket and eating food, depicting a happy family outing or gathering.
During a family outing, Melanie and her family played games, ate good food, and spent time hanging out together.
Melanie deeply values and cherishes time with family; family moments make Melanie feel alive, happy, motivated, and that life is worthwhile.
Caroline believes that spending time with loved ones brings happiness and that family is everything.
On June 27, 2023, Caroline shared a photo of a person holding a necklace with a cross and a heart. The necklace was a childhood gift from Caroline's grandmother in Sweden, Caroline's home country.
Caroline's necklace from her grandmother symbolizes love, faith, and strength, and reminds Caroline of her Swedish roots and the love and support Caroline receives from Caroline's family.

On June 27, 2023, Melanie shared a photo showing a stack of bowls with different designs. Caroline owns a hand-painted bowl made by a friend for Caroline's 18th birthday approximately ten years earlier, around 2013.
Caroline values her hand-painted bowl because its pattern and colors remind Caroline of art and self-expression.

During the week before June 27, 2023, Melanie took her husband and children camping in the mountains. Melanie's family explored nature, roasted marshmallows around a campfire, and hiked; the view from the summit was amazing.
Melanie said that Melanie's two younger children love nature, and that the mountain camping trip created special family moments Melanie will never forget.
Melanie considers family time important and deeply values making memories with Melanie's husband and children.
Caroline is exploring counseling and mental health as a career so Caroline can help people who have gone through experiences similar to Caroline's.
Caroline is considering specializing in counseling and mental health services for transgender people, helping transgender clients accept themselves and supporting their mental health.

On June 23, 2023, Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop that covered different therapeutic methods and best practices for working with transgender people. Caroline found the workshop enlightening and was impressed by the professionals' passion for creating safe spaces for transgender people.

Caroline's interest in counseling and mental health is motivated by Caroline's own transition journey and the support Caroline received. Counseling and support groups significantly improved Caroline's life, increased Caroline's interest in mental health and self-understanding, and inspired Caroline to create safe, welcoming places where people can grow.
Caroline is passionate about creating safe, inviting environments where people can accept themselves, receive mental-health support, and grow.

Melanie strongly encouraged Caroline's counseling and mental-health ambitions, describing Caroline's dedication as impressive and inspiring, praising Caroline's hard work and impact, and congratulating Caroline for pursuing meaningful work.
On June 27, 2023, Caroline shared a photo showing a bookshelf with many books on it while discussing Caroline's interest in counseling and mental health.
On June 27, 2023, Melanie shared a photo showing a bookshelf filled with books in a room while congratulating Caroline on pursuing counseling and mental-health work.
Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ pride parade during the week before July 3, 2023. Caroline felt happy, a sense of belonging, and amazement at how much the LGBTQ+ community had grown.

Caroline said the pride parade motivated her to use her personal story to help others. Caroline remains interested in counseling and mental health as a way to give back, particularly to the LGBTQ+ community.
Melanie signed up for a pottery class on July 2, 2023, because pottery helps her express herself, be creative, process emotions, and feel calm and joyful.
Melanie showed Caroline a photo of a bowl with a black-and-white flower design. Melanie said she made the bowl in her pottery class and felt proud of the work.
Melanie shared a photo showing a person holding a frisbee in their hand.
Caroline is learning to play the piano as a creative activity.
Caroline plans to attend a transgender conference in July 2023 to meet other people in the transgender community and learn more about advocacy. Caroline is very excited about the conference.
Caroline and Melanie continue to encourage and celebrate each other's personal growth, creative interests, and LGBTQ+ community involvement.

On July 6, 2023, Caroline told Melanie that she had been looking more into counseling or mental health work since their last chat. Caroline said she was passionate about helping people and making a positive impact, and that the work was difficult but rewarding.
On July 5, 2023, Melanie took her children to a museum, enjoyed spending time with them, and watched their eyes light up during the visit.
On July 5, 2023, Melanie shared a photograph showing two children playing in a water play area at a museum.
On July 6, 2023, Caroline thought the photograph Melanie shared was great and expressed enthusiasm about Melanie's museum outing with her children.

On July 6, 2023, Melanie said her child was excited about a dinosaur exhibit, loved learning about animals, and thought the dinosaur bones were very cool. Melanie said the experience reminded her why she loves being a mom.

On July 6, 2023, Caroline said she was creating a library for her future children and was looking forward to reading to them and opening their minds. Caroline shared a photo of a bookcase filled with books and toys.
Caroline's planned children's library includes classic children's books, stories from different cultures, educational books, and a broad variety of other children's books.

Melanie remembers Charlotte's Web as a favorite childhood book and values its theme that friendship and compassion can make a difference. Melanie shared a photo of a book cover depicting a girl and a cat.
On June 29-July 5, 2023, Caroline had a picnic with her friends and family in a park; Caroline shared a photo showing a group of women sitting together on a blanket.

Caroline said that her friends and family have supported her transition with love, guidance, acceptance, encouragement, and unconditional support at every step. Caroline said this support helped her accept and grow into her true self and was instrumental in her transition.
On July 6, 2023, Melanie shared a photo of her family sitting around a campfire on a beach and said that her family loves camping at the beach because it brings them closer together.
Caroline expressed appreciation for how important friendship and compassion are and said she feels lucky to have friends and family helping her through her transition.
Melanie said that unconditional love is very important and expressed happiness that Caroline has a strong support network.

On July 10, 2023, Caroline attended an LGBTQ conference where she met people with similar journeys, felt welcomed and totally accepted, appreciated the LGBTQ community, and became more committed to fighting for transgender rights and spreading awareness.
Caroline believes LGBTQ rights have advanced significantly but that substantial progress is still needed, and Caroline wants to help make a difference.
As of July 12, 2023, Caroline was still exploring counseling and mental health careers because Caroline wants people to have someone to talk to and hopes to provide that support.

Caroline has personally struggled with mental health and found the support Caroline received very helpful. That experience led Caroline to explore counseling and mental health career options so Caroline can support people through journeys similar to Caroline's own.
On July 12, 2023, Melanie shared a photograph of a book cover featuring a gold coin. Melanie said the book, which Melanie read in 2022, reminded Melanie to pursue dreams.
Caroline loves reading and considers books an important part of Caroline's personal journey because books guide Caroline, motivate Caroline, and help Caroline discover who Caroline is.

Caroline's favorite inspirational book is "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt, a true story about a transgender girl and her family. The book made Caroline feel connected and hopeful about Caroline's own path, and Caroline highly recommends it.

Caroline took from "Becoming Nicole" the lessons of self-acceptance, finding support, and hope that difficult times do not last and that love exists. Caroline also believes pets bring joy and comfort.
On July 12, 2023, Caroline shared a photograph of a dog sitting in a boat on the water while discussing "Becoming Nicole" and the joy pets provide.
On July 12, 2023, Melanie shared a photograph of two little girls sitting on steps with a dog and agreed that pets provide joy and comfort.
Melanie has a dog and a cat as pets.
On July 12, 2023, Melanie shared a photo of her cat lying on the floor with its head resting on the floor.
Melanie said that her dog and cat brighten her day and always make her smile.
Caroline considers Melanie's dog and cat adorable and said that pets bring people a lot of joy.

Caroline and Melanie are supportive friends. Caroline is transgender, transitioned around 2020 after moving from Sweden, and has known her friends for four years as of June 9, 2023. Caroline spoke at a school event in early June 2023 about her journey, LGBTQ+ involvement, inclusion, and allyship. Caroline treasures a childhood cross-and-heart necklace from her Swedish grandmother and a hand-painted bowl made for her 18th birthday around 2013. Caroline is exploring counseling and mental health as a career, especially supporting transgender people; she attended an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop on June 23, a pride parade in late June, and an LGBTQ conference on July 10, 2023. Caroline is learning piano, loves reading, and recommends Becoming Nicole by Amy Ellis Nutt. Melanie has a dog and a cat; on July 12, 2023, Melanie shared a photo of the cat lying on the floor with its head resting on the floor. Melanie says the pets brighten her day and make her smile. Their names are not yet known.
Melanie has pets named Luna and Oliver; Melanie describes Luna and Oliver as sweet and playful and says they liven up her house.
On July 12, 2023, Melanie shared photos of new pink running sneakers: one photo showed a person wearing the sneakers on a white rug, and another showed a pair of the sneakers in a box.
Melanie has been running farther and more regularly to destress, clear her mind, and improve her headspace; she finds running beneficial for her mental health and plans to continue.
Caroline encouraged Melanie to keep running, noting that running can boost mood and emphasizing that mental health should be a priority.
On July 14, 2023, Melanie took her children to a pottery workshop. Melanie and her children each made clay pots, and Melanie found the activity fun and therapeutic.

Melanie's children loved the pottery workshop and enjoyed getting their hands dirty, making clay objects, and expressing their creativity and imagination. One photographed creation was a cup decorated with a dog face.
Melanie and her children have recently enjoyed painting together, especially nature-inspired paintings.
On the weekend of July 8-9, 2023, Melanie and her children jointly painted a bold-colored sunset scene featuring a palm tree, using the project to bond and talk about nature.
Around the weekend of July 8-9, 2023, Melanie and her children found a field of purple flowers with green leaves and appreciated the small things in nature.

On July 14, 2023, Caroline attended a council meeting about adoption. The meeting was inspiring and emotional because many people wanted to create loving homes for children in need, and it strengthened Caroline's determination to adopt in the future.
Melanie shared a photograph of a blue vase containing a bouquet of sunflowers and roses.
Caroline's favorite color is blue; blue makes Caroline feel relaxed.
Caroline associates sunflowers with warmth and happiness and roses with love and beauty.
Melanie says flowers bring her joy and represent growth, beauty, and appreciating small moments. Flowers were an important part of Melanie's wedding decor and remind Melanie of her wedding day.
Melanie shared a photo showing a row of white chairs decorated with flowers, likely from her wedding.
Melanie described her wedding as amazing and full of love and joy, with everyone she and her partner love present to celebrate them.
Melanie shared a photo of a wedding ceremony in a greenhouse while people took pictures.
Melanie says the best part of her wedding was marrying her partner and promising to be together forever.
Melanie shared a photo of a man and a woman standing together on a beach in connection with her wedding; the people in the photo were not explicitly identified.

Caroline attended and participated in a pride parade a few weeks before July 15, 2023, likely in late June or early July 2023. Caroline shared photos of the parade, including people walking down a street and a smiling group holding signs.
At the pride parade, Caroline felt accepted, happy, proud, grateful, comforted, and inspired. Caroline felt less alone because the community accepted, celebrated, embraced, and supported Caroline.
Caroline shared a photo of a rainbow flag on a pole standing on a carpet.
Caroline shared a photo of a group of people sitting on the ground with a dog while discussing support from friends and community.
Caroline shared a photo of a teepee containing a teddy bear and pillows; Melanie also shared a photo showing a girl sitting in a teepee with stuffed animals.

Caroline says the best part of her transition journey was realizing Caroline could be herself without fear and finding the courage to transition. Caroline experiences expressing herself authentically with others' support as freeing.
Caroline is proud of how far Caroline has come after a long road in her transition journey.
Melanie says creativity and family help Melanie find peace.
Melanie shared a photo of a man holding a frisbee in front of a frisbee golf basket.
Melanie's family supported Melanie during her move by helping out and showing substantial love and support. Melanie says her family's love and support helped her through tough times.
Melanie and her family went on another camping trip in the forest.
Melanie shared a photo of a man and two children sitting around a campfire during a forest camping trip.
Caroline shared a photo of a family walking through a forest with a toddler while asking Melanie what her family likes doing together.
Melanie enjoys hiking in the mountains and exploring forests as a way to connect with nature and with family and friends.
Melanie considers hiking in the mountains and exploring forests among her favorite memories because these activities bring her family together and make her happy.
Caroline and Melanie value their friendship and support one another; Caroline said Melanie’s friendship means a great deal to her, and Melanie appreciated having Caroline as a supporter.
On the weekend of July 15–16, 2023, Caroline joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth and found it rewarding to help the community.
By July 17, 2023, Caroline had met several LGBTQ young people through the mentorship program and supported them; Caroline was inspired by their resilience and strength.

Caroline mentors a transgender teen who is like Caroline, and they have been working on building the teen's confidence and finding positive strategies; Caroline said the work was paying off by July 17, 2023.

Caroline and the transgender teen Caroline mentors attended an LGBTQ Pride event in June 2023. Caroline described the event as full of love and acceptance and shared a photo showing a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air.
Caroline's most memorable moment at the June 2023 LGBTQ Pride event was seeing the transgender mentee's face light up when the mentee saw the surrounding support.
Melanie said that she and her family went camping with the children approximately two weekends before July 17, 2023, and Melanie enjoyed unplugging and spending time with the children.
Caroline plans to hold an LGBTQ art show featuring her paintings in August 2023.
Melanie shared a photo preview showing a painting with a blue-and-yellow design while asking Caroline for previews of Caroline's LGBTQ art show artwork.
Caroline shared a photo of her art-show painting: a tree with a bright sun in the background.
Caroline painted the tree-and-sun artwork after visiting an LGBTQ center; Caroline intended the painting to capture everyone's unity and strength.
Melanie praised Caroline's painting as awesome and gorgeous, describing its colors as vivid and the composition as unified, and saying it conveyed unity and strength.
Melanie said that Melanie and Melanie's children had just finished another painting similar to their previous painting.
On July 11, 2023, Caroline joined a new LGBTQ activist group called Connected LGBTQ Activists.
Connected LGBTQ Activists includes people with diverse backgrounds who work toward positive change, hold regular meetings, plan events and campaigns, and support one another.
Caroline feels fulfilled and believes she is making a real difference by speaking up for LGBTQ+ rights, community support, equality, and inclusivity through Connected LGBTQ Activists.

During the weekend of July 15–16, 2023, Caroline's city held a Pride parade where people marched through the streets with flags and signs while celebrating love and diversity; Caroline did not attend, but the parade reminded her that LGBTQ+ people are not alone and that change is possible.
Melanie recently went to the beach with children, who had a great time; Melanie shared a photo showing three children playing on the beach with a kite.

On July 20, 2023, Melanie said her children were very happy at the beach; Melanie's family usually visits the beach only once or twice a year, making each visit a special time to relax and spend time together. Melanie shared a photo of a sandcastle on the beach under a blue sky.

Melanie's family looks forward to an annual summer camping trip as a major family tradition. During the camping trip, Melanie's family roasts marshmallows, tells stories around a campfire, and enjoys each other's company.

During Melanie's family's camping trip in 2022, Melanie and her family watched the Perseid meteor shower. Melanie described lying down and watching streaks of light across the sky, making wishes together, and feeling connected with the universe; Melanie considers this a memory she will never forget. Melanie shared a photo showing an airplane against a star-filled sky.

On July 20, 2023, Melanie described seeing a clear, star-filled sky and an amazing meteor shower. She said the experience made her feel tiny and in awe of the universe, as though she were part of something huge and awe-inspiring. Melanie shared a photo showing a plane flying in the sky with a trail of smoke.

On July 20, 2023, Melanie said that small moments such as witnessing the universe and enjoying nature remind her how awesome and fleeting life is. She shared a photo of a beach with footprints in the sand beneath a blue sky.

Melanie recalled that her youngest child’s first steps were a particularly meaningful memory. Watching the child wobble through those initial steps made Melanie reflect on how fleeting life is and how lucky she is to share such milestones.

On July 20, 2023, Caroline responded warmly to Melanie’s story about her youngest child’s first steps, saying that milestones are reminders of how special family bonds are. Caroline shared a photo showing a baby in a white crib with a blue blanket.

Melanie said on July 20, 2023, that she feels lucky to be with her family and to share their love. She described her family as a source of great joy and love, and shared a photo of a family standing on a beach at sunset.

On August 13, 2023, Melanie celebrated her daughter's birthday by attending a Matt Patterson concert with her children. Melanie enjoyed the music, joy, warm summer breeze, and seeing her children's smiles; she felt thankful for the special family moments.
Melanie said Matt Patterson performed at her daughter's birthday concert and described Matt Patterson as very talented, with an amazing voice and songs.

Caroline attended a pride parade on Friday, August 11, 2023. Caroline experienced the parade as energetic and full of love, felt proud, and was reminded of the importance of standing up for equality and fighting for LGBTQ rights.
Caroline had previously attended an advocacy event and described it as a cool experience filled with love and support.
Melanie believes it is important to cultivate a loving and accepting environment for her children.
Caroline considers representing inclusivity and diversity in her art important. Caroline uses her art to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and promote acceptance.
On August 14, 2023, Melanie shared a photo from the August 13 Matt Patterson concert showing a group of people seated on chairs watching a band perform.
On August 14, 2023, Melanie shared a photo of a band performing on stage beneath a sign reading “all are welcome,” reflecting the concert's welcoming atmosphere.
On August 14, 2023, Caroline shared a photo of a group of people walking down a street with balloons during the pride parade.

On August 14, 2023, Caroline shared a photo of a painting with a paintbrush and paint, presenting it as a recent artwork connected to her commitment to inclusivity, diversity, LGBTQ+ advocacy, and acceptance.
Caroline's art expresses Caroline's trans experience, shares Caroline's personal story, and helps people understand the trans community.
On August 14, 2023, Caroline shared a painting depicting a woman with a cow in her lap while explaining that Caroline's art expresses Caroline's trans experience.
Melanie considers Caroline's art amazing and values Caroline's use of art to tell personal stories and teach people about trans people.
On August 14, 2023, Melanie shared a photo of a person holding a purple bowl while discussing Caroline's artwork.

Caroline created a painting titled "Embracing Identity" about finding comfort and love in being oneself; the woman in the painting represents the journey of acceptance, and Caroline intended the painting to convey warmth, love, and self-acceptance.
On August 14, 2023, Caroline shared a photo of a painting featuring a woman wearing a red shirt while discussing Caroline's painting "Embracing Identity."
Melanie thinks Caroline's painting is gorgeous and appreciates its themes of self-acceptance and love.
On August 14, 2023, Melanie shared a photo of a woman making a vase on a pottery wheel while asking Caroline how art supports Caroline's self-discovery and acceptance journey.
Caroline uses art to explore Caroline's transition and changing body, work through personal experiences, and learn to accept the beauty of imperfections.
Melanie believes art can be healing, can help people connect with who they are, and can reveal beauty in imperfections; Melanie believes every individual is wonderfully imperfect.
Caroline values sharing Caroline's art and personal experiences with Melanie, and Caroline said Melanie's supportive response meant a lot to Caroline.
On August 14, 2023, Melanie warmly ended a conversation with Caroline by saying it was great chatting and inviting Caroline to reach out at any time.

On August 17, 2023, Caroline described having a distressing experience while hiking after encountering religious conservatives who said something upsetting to Caroline. The experience reminded Caroline that more work is needed for LGBTQ+ rights, but Caroline felt reassured that accepting and supportive people would help Caroline be okay.
On August 17, 2023, Melanie showed Caroline a photo of Melanie's latest pottery project: a bowl decorated with a colorful design featuring many colors and patterns.
Melanie is obsessed with colorful designs, colors, and patterns, and made a brightly decorated pottery bowl to catch people's eyes and make them smile.

Melanie experiences painting and pottery as ways to express feelings and creativity; Melanie feels that each brushstroke carries part of Melanie. Art is a sanctuary, a source of comfort, a major learning experience, and a source of happiness and fulfillment for Melanie.
Caroline believes that surrounding oneself with joyful things, finding happy moments, and holding onto those moments are important ways to keep going when life is difficult.

On August 17, 2023, Caroline and Melanie mutually expressed that their friendship makes life's struggles more bearable, that they appreciate one another, and that each has been there for the other. Caroline told Melanie that Caroline is always there for Melanie.

Caroline recalled having a great time with supportive friends at a Pride festival in 2022 and shared a photo showing a group of people walking down a street with balloons. Caroline said that supportive friends make everything worthwhile.

On August 17, 2023, Melanie and Caroline agreed to plan a special summer outing together, possibly a family outing or a nature-focused trip just for the two of them, to catch up and create happy memories.
On August 17, 2023, Melanie said she would start thinking about activities for the special summer outing with Caroline.
On August 17, 2023, Caroline expressed excitement and anticipation about taking the trip with Melanie and making awesome memories together.
On 2023-08-23, Caroline took the first step toward becoming a mother by applying to adoption agencies after receiving helpful advice and assistance from an adoption support group.
On 2023-08-23, Caroline said she felt excited but somewhat nervous about pursuing adoption because parenting is a major responsibility, and she was ready to give all her love to a child.
Caroline owns a guinea pig named Oscar. Oscar enjoys vegetables, especially parsley; Caroline shared a photo of Oscar eating parsley in a cage with hay.
Melanie has pets including a cat named Bailey and a pet named Oliver; Melanie shared a photo identified as Oliver showing a black dog lying in grass with a frisbee.
Melanie said Oliver once hid his bone in her slipper, which she found funny.
Melanie once fed a horse a carrot and shared a photo of a person holding a carrot in front of a horse.
Melanie congratulated Caroline on applying to adoption agencies, expressed pride in Caroline, normalized feeling both excited and nervous about a major decision, and asked about Caroline's pets.
Caroline has loved horses since childhood and used to go horseback riding through fields with her father, enjoying the wind and feeling that the experience was special.

Melanie recently painted a horse on a wooden wall; the shared photo showed the horse painting. Melanie loves painting animals, especially horses, because painting feels peaceful and special and horses have grace.
Caroline recently made a self-portrait the week before 2023-08-23; the shared photo showed a painting of a woman with a blue face.

Caroline loves creating art and uses painting to express herself, explore her identity, and be true to herself. She felt liberated and empowered while making her blue-faced self-portrait and considers painting therapeutic.
Caroline believes art gives her a sense of freedom, and supportive people, promoting LGBTQ rights, and being true to herself also help her feel free and live authentically.
Caroline wants to help other people live authentically and remain committed to her adoption journey; Melanie wished Caroline the best and Caroline said she was excited for the future.

Melanie affirmed Caroline's artistic self-expression, LGBTQ-rights advocacy, authenticity, and adoption journey, and told Caroline that Melanie was there for her and encouraged her to take care of herself.

Between August 18 and August 24, 2023, Caroline went hiking, got into a difficult situation with some people, felt bothered by what happened, and tried to apologize to them. Caroline shared a photo of a woman sitting on a sign at the top of a mountain.
Melanie told Caroline that she was sorry the hiking incident happened and praised Caroline's apology as courageous and mature.
Melanie shared a photo of a plate decorated with many flowers and asked Caroline what she thought of it.
Caroline said Melanie's flower-decorated plate was awesome and asked Melanie whether Melanie had made it.
On 2023-08-24, Melanie made a flower-decorated plate in pottery class. Melanie loves pottery because it is relaxing and creative; Caroline has not tried pottery and has been busy painting.

On 2023-08-25, Caroline shared photos of a recently finished sunset painting on a small easel and a painting of a sunset over the ocean. The painting uses vivid colors and was inspired by Caroline visiting the beach the previous week, watching the sun dip below the horizon, and feeling amazed, calm, peaceful, and serene.

Caroline feels that art can communicate peace and serenity, create emotional connection, and help people understand one another. Melanie agrees that art connects people and helps them understand each other.

On 2023-08-24, Melanie spent the day volunteering with her family at a homeless shelter. Melanie found it difficult to see how neglected some people are, but felt good that the volunteers could make a difference.
On 2023-08-25, Caroline praised Melanie as amazing and inspirational for volunteering and making a difference, and shared a photo of a crowd walking down a street with a rainbow flag.
